== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-rectenna-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Rectenna (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): Same game text. The game text is set again and the white “E” in the lower border is gone; a small round bronze disc sits in the lower right corner of the card.

The whole earlier image and the whole new image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
